basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rajkot (AIIMS Rajkot) has announced 3 contract vacancies for Project Research Scientist - I (non-Medical) and Project Technical Support – II posts. Qualifications vary by post, and the initial appointment is for 3 months, extendable up to 12 months or till completion of project. The notified pay is Rs. 56,000 + HRA for Project Research Scientist - I (non-Medical) and Rs. 20,000 + HRA for Project Technical Support – II. Eligible candidates can submit their online application by 30 October 2026. Selection involves a scrutiny of applications followed by an

how_to_apply: Fill out the application form available on the last pages of the official advertisement in the prescribed format.

Prepare one set of self-attested photocopies of required documents including date of birth proof, photo ID, educational certificates, mark sheets, PhD certificate, registration certificate, experience certificates, and publications.
Submit a soft copy of the application along with scanned copies of attachments through the Google Form link: https://forms.gle/1nBjJ6TkoJHLuPtp9 by 30 October 2026 till 5 PM.
Bring a physical copy of the filled application form, all original documents, and one set of xerox copies for document verification during the reporting for the written test/interview.
important_instructions: Candidates reporting after 9 AM on the day of the exam/interview will not be considered. Persons working in Government/Public Sector undertakings or any other research project at AIIMS Rajkot must produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Selected candidates will have no claim to any regular post in AIIMS Rajkot at any time. Selected candidates may have to work in shifts/night duty, go on field visits, and travel outstation as required. Submission of wrong or false information at any stage will lead to disqualification or termination.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree with PhD in Biological Sciences/Biomedical relevant subject
rows.desirable_qualification: Minimum two publications in indexed journals with good impact factor; Experience in clinical research projects/data management; Sound computer knowledge and statistical software handling; Experience in multicentric/extramural projects will be preferred

rows.essential_qualification: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field OR Three Years Graduate degree in Biological Science or relevant subject / field + two years’ experience in medical laboratory/relevant subject
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in clinical research projects/data management; Working knowledge of computer applications (MS Office), blood sample collection, sample processing & analysis, and data management

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The initial appointment is for a period of 03 months. It may be extended further up to 12 months or till the completion of the project, depending upon the candidate's performance, the continuation of the scheme, and the budget grant from the funding agency. House Rent Allowance (HRA), if admissible as per the funding agency's guidelines, shall be paid for the classification of Rajkot city (Class 'Y'). The contract will automatically expire on completion of the stipulated time or earlier in case of withdrawal of support by the funding agency, and can be terminated by either side by giving 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be scrutinized by a screening committee. For Project Research Scientist - I (non-Medical), selection is by interview only; a written test may be conducted only if eligible candidates exceed 30 to shortlist candidates. For Project Technical Support – II, the selection involves a written exam/skill test followed by an interview for up to six candidates per available post who secure the highest marks in the MCQ-based written test. The relative weightage of the written exam and interview will be 80% and 20% respectively for final merit determination. The written exam/interview is scheduled for 26 November 2026 at 9 AM in the Seminar Room, Department of Biochemistry, Academic Block, AIIMS Rajkot.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 9 AM on the day of the exam/interview will not be considered. Persons working in Government/Public Sector undertakings or any other research project at AIIMS Rajkot must produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Selected candidates will have no claim to any regular post in AIIMS Rajkot at any time. Selected candidates may have to work in shifts/night duty, go on field visits, and travel outstation as required. Submission of wrong or false information at any stage will lead to disqualification or termination.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026 is a project-based recruitment drive for hiring 3 contractual positions under an ICMR-funded research project titled "Development and Validation of the SAS-India" in the Department of Biochemistry.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available, comprising 1 post for Project Research Scientist - I (non-Medical) and 2 posts for Project Technical Support – II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Rajkot project posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application via the Google Form is 30 October 2026 till 5 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate Degree with a PhD in Biological Sciences or a biomedical relevant subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these project posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 35 years, with age relaxation applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for Project Technical Support – II?
faq.answer: The monthly emolument for Project Technical Support – II is Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for Project Technical Support – II?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a written exam/skill test followed by an interview, where the written exam and interview carry 80% and 20% weightage respectively.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job at AIIMS Rajkot?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely on a contract basis for an externally funded research project, and selected candidates have no claim to any regular post in AIIMS Rajkot.

faq.question: Q9. What relaxations are given in age limits?
faq.answer: Age limit is relaxable for SC/ST candidates for up to 5 years, for OBC candidates for up to 3 years, and for PwBD candidates up to 10 years (13 years for OBC, 15 years for SC/ST).

faq.question: Q10. Where will the written exam and interview take place?
faq.answer: The written exam/interview will be held on 26 November 2026 at 9 AM in the Seminar Room, Department of Biochemistry, Academic Block, AIIMS Rajkot.
